recommendation: Outcome C: PaddleOCR warrants a restricted image-based characteristic-table challenger; keep Tesseract primary globally. No production recognizer selection or integration is approved by these measurements.

config.language_requested: en; ignored by PaddleOCR when explicit models supplied
config.recognizer_language: English mobile; multilingual server includes English
config.suspect_sampling: first two suspect blocks per warning page; two representative numeric blocks per selected page
config.network: macOS sandbox deny network* for inference; setup downloads public models only

failures.reason: Long first full-page four-repetition attempt was manually interrupted; subsequent bounded-detector replay completed. Exit -4 retained without inferring a dependency incompatibility.

limits: 13-page selected pilot, not all 102 corpus pages
Numeric headline permits only separating known label/value adjacency (SAN1 -> SAN 1); glyphs are never repaired. Production raw metric is separate
Only bounded regions with visually reviewed references count toward headline quality metrics
Full-page native references are unverified evidence; metrics do not establish accuracy
Source warning crops are contents headings; image tables are representative, not production-suspect crops
No verified whole-page sentence-addition gold; no claim of zero sentence hallucinations
Geometry probe is limited to the two visually verified image tables; multiword segments excluded instead of guessed; raw checks remain separate
Fixed engine order and overlapping runs: timings are descriptive, not a comparative throughput verdict
Python 3.11 isolated benchmark differs from bot Python 3.14; Linux compatibility not executed

records.method: actual OCR single-token boxes mapped from 300 DPI pixels into crop-local PDF points; numeric_pairs owner

engine_setup_failure_recovered.resolution: launch OS-denied-network worker from approved outer process

known_missing_fields.diagnostic: faint +1 / -1 age-modifier cells omitted by both Paddle recognizers across two gold crops; also not recovered by baseline

model_selection: Mobile/server tied on all verified headline quality metrics and 16/16 main-stat geometry pairs. Do not pick production model from a default or confounded timings; keep both for expanded gold coverage.

runner_current_limits.timeout_policy: outer watchdog terminate/kill process group and reap; timeout remains failure; original manual interruption preserved
